title: Record the holder in the test launcher's recovery.lock so a stale lock can be diagnosed or cleared
outcome: From tm-uex8 review round 3 (Claude reviewer, Low). recovery.lock is created empty, so a lock left by a killed 'recover' blocks later recovers until someone deletes it by hand (docs/test.md documents that step). Fix direction: write the recovering process's pid and a start time into the lock, name that pid in the 'another recovery in progress' error, and optionally treat a lock whose holder is proven dead (processMayBeAlive/ESRCH) as stale. Keep the policy that only proof of exit counts.
